summary: Fixed-boundary subset dynamic programming reorders a small route segment while keeping its incident vertices fixed.
description: Input is a complete matrix, distinct interior vertices, and fixed entry and exit vertices outside the block. The endpoints may coincide at a depot. Return the optimal internal order with fixed boundary arcs.

Memoize the best suffix by the current vertex and remaining mask. One helper enumerates feasible CVRP subsets and calls the same solver with depot at both ends. Single-block work is exponential in block size. The subset helper is intended only for small CVRP examples.
